## Checklist

- [ ] I ran the affected experiment(s) locally and confirmed they still render (interactive and, if relevant, `--save`).
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) with a scope.
- [ ] I quoted paths that contain spaces in any commands I documented.
- [ ] If I changed the physics, I documented any approximations in the code and the README so the project stays honest about what it computes.
- [ ] If I added tests, `pytest` passes locally and I wired the command into CI / documented it.
- [ ] Code is clean and, if I ran it, `ruff check .` and `ruff format .` are happy.
- [ ] I updated the README / README-PT (both, since they mirror each other) if user-facing behavior changed.
